In Columbus, 13 studios compete for dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 13 dance and ballroom studios serving the Columbus market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 49 to 92. The AI engines name only ten of the 13. The field averages 60 (D) on AI readiness, 13 of 13 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 11 of 13 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 4 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Columbus, OH area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 13 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • The Crystal Ballroom Dance Center (92) and Columbus Dance Centre (91) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 49. One score is shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 60 (D) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • None of the 13 studios has FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 11 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Four of the 13 are franchise locations (one Arthur Murray and three Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #13 is 43 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Columbus.” Studios that serve Columbus from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (13 studios): crystalballroomcolumbus.com, columbusdancecentre.com, dance-plus.com, eadanceart.com, fredastaire.com/pickerington, fredastaire.com/powell, fredastaire.com/westerville, columbusnorthwestdancestudio.com, columbussalsaclasses.com, ohiodanceinc.com, mydanceedge.com, lincolnstreetsalsa.com, columbuslatindance.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 4 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Columbus dance searches. Columbus Salsa Classes and Viva Dance Columbus share a studio at 2809 Festival Lane in Dublin, so they're rated as one. Left out: Ballroom Avenue (Dublin), which ChatGPT and Google AI both named but whose website didn't load on the audit date, Emerald City Ballroom (Dublin), whose site is a 'we are moving' placeholder, Ballroom Dance Experience's separate Google listing (it's the same studio as Dance Plus), studios with no website of their own (Too Left Feet Dancing, ConfiDance Ballroom Academy), Grandview Salsa (a salsa social night, not a studio), youth, ballet, contemporary and competition-team studios (Artisan, Pinnell, Marjorie Jones, Dance E.L.I.T.E., FLUX + FLOW, Lineage, Columbus Dance Theatre), and pole, fitness and heels studios (Studio Rouge, DivaDance, Swerve).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 4 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Columbus, OH?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Columbus, OH?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's public web app (ChatGPT logged out, Gemini in a temporary chat, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 4 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons columbus oh”; “dance lessons columbus oh”; “salsa lessons columbus oh”; “wedding dance lessons columbus oh”; “ballroom dance lessons westerville oh”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in columbus oh” and “ballroom dance studio columbus”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
